choices.why: It is the only dark wood bookcase, close in tone to the floor, and tall enough to anchor the left wall with plenty of shelf space.
The cognac leather armchair is deep and comfortable for reading, and its warm tone and wooden legs suit the cozy look.
An adjustable reading lamp of the right height whose matte black matches the window frames and the bookcase.
This rustic solid-wood side table adds natural warmth and sits at a good height next to the armchair for a coffee cup.
The only round light-colored rug, in natural jute, to define the reading corner under the armchair and table.
The cream cotton throw with chunky tassels looks great on the cognac leather and adds natural texture.
Light, sheer white curtains soften the large corner window without blocking the natural light needed for reading; two panels cover both sides.

answer.why: The dark wood of the bookcase echoes the floor, while the cognac leather, jute, rustic wood, and natural textiles add warmth against the white walls and concrete. Black accents on the lamp and bookcase tie in with the window frames.
